distinguishing_features: Anti-phase acoustic pressure cancellation in the bowl air gap rather than generic transient shear generation.
Use of the centrifuge hydraulic drive pressure modulator and tangential injection ports as the acoustic actuator.
Phase-lock loop driven by bowl accelerometer phase to set injection phase.
Treatment of the air gap as an acoustic waveguide/vortex-shedding forcing path rather than a process shear zone.
